exposure: postpartum day 1 systolic blood pressure levels
outcome: postpartum readmission due to severe hypertension
cohort: The study included 4,317 women with antepartum pregnancy-associated hypertension diagnosed prior to initial discharge between January 2009 and December 2016.
finding: Non-Hispanic Black women had increased odds of postpartum readmission due to hypertension compared with non-Hispanic White women (aOR = 2.12; 95% CI: 1.16-3.87), alongside older maternal age.
